_comment: WildTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{mark}: The mark being placed, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[X 4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in Wild Tic Tac Toe.
On your turn, you can place either an 'X' or an 'O' in an empty square.
You win by aligning three of the same mark (X or O) in a row.
You can win with either symbol.
Choose your move using the format '[X 4]' to place X in the center.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Invalid move format. Use '[X 4]' or '[O 2]' format.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Invalid cell number: {cell}. Must be between 0 and 8.
invalid_move.already_occupied: Invalid move. Cell {cell} is already occupied.

game_action.placed: Player {player_id} placed their symbol ({mark}) in cell {cell}
